verification_report.summary: The chapter is correct under the stated hypotheses and accepted standard inputs. Every proof was checked in textual order. The flag valuation and one-dimensional-leaf count are valid. The residual bundles have the correct negative divisor twists, and Poincare–Lelong with Gauduchon Stokes yields the stated linear recursion, including a_n=1 and negative-degree cases. Genuine graded multiplication gives the additive semigroup; its closed-cone slice equals the defined compact convex body. Disjoint lattice cubes prove the upper bound, including empty bodies and lower-dimensional bodies. SGPT's supplied appendix thm:KK12growth and chapter thm:HausOkoun match the exact count: full Z^(n+1) generation removes both lattice-index and degree-period factors. Common-degree powers and distinct monomial valuations correctly prove algebraic independence without that arithmetic hypothesis. The projective-modification input matches [Moi67, Introduction p.1332](https://www.mathnet.ru/php/getFT.phtml?jrnid=im&option_lang=eng&paperid=2594&what=fullteng): its sequence of monoidal transformations ends in a nonsingular projective variety, and its reduced-space convention is satisfied by smooth X. The bounded-mass pullback proof is valid for bounded potentials and smooth nonclosed backgrounds: biholomorphic naturality and absence of mass on analytic sets justify equality of integrals; mixed-product positivity gives the inequality; Stokes is used only in the closed Kahler background. [GL22, Lemma 3.6, first bullet](https://content.algebraicgeometry.nl/2022-6/2022-6-021.pdf) corroborates precisely this modification case. The final contrapositive therefore gives zero body volume and dim W_m=o(m^n). The n=1 case is consistent, the empty-body case is covered, and no general existence of complete flags or bounded mass is assumed. Detailed deduction and reference checks are persisted in memory/flag_bodies_01.
